title: The question before the clever answer
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Name the decision — What will change after the answer?; Locate uncertainty — Identify the distinction that matters.; Ask for an example — Use an event or observable boundary.; Hear the response — Allow the evidence to change the framing.; Choose the next step — Investigate, decide, or revise the question..
